cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.description: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.description: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

cards.name: Zarude
cards.description: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

cards.name: Calyrex
cards.description: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

cards.name: Radiant Charizard
cards.description: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it's trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
cards.description: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.description: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.description: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.description: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.description: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.description: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

cards.name: Radiant Charjabug
cards.description: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.description: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

cards.name: Enamorus
cards.description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.description: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.description: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.description: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.description: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.description: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.description: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.description: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth
cards.description: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.description: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.description: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

cards.name: Zamazenta
cards.description: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

cards.name: Radiant Eternatus
cards.description: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Starly
cards.description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.description: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

cards.name: Gumshoos
cards.description: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.description: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.description: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

cards.name: Dubwool
cards.description: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
